premises.text: Searching for fashion items using images is frustrating and often yields poor results
premises.evidence_span: I remember being in this party and seeing Alexa Chung wearing this beautiful jumper... and actually getting home and trying to translate the image that I had in my head into words in order to Google it. And it was so frustrating, and the results I got were terrible.

premises.text: The app can find fashion items based on images and suggest alternatives
premises.evidence_span: the system has managed to find exactly the same item and also suggest some really cool ones.

premises.text: Users can submit queries to personal stylists if the app fails to find the desired item
premises.evidence_span: you can submit the query to a personal stylist. So, yeah, your very own personal stylist, a human being that will be behind the computer searching the item on your behalf.

premises.text: The app includes a social network feature for sharing and discovering fashion inspiration
premises.evidence_span: we have also an Instagram for fashion feature, a social network, where you can inspire people and get inspiration as well.

premises.text: The company has a unique approach by combining technology with human interaction
premises.evidence_span: we're taking a unique approach. Our system is better simply because our team has experience.

premises.text: The business model includes affiliate commissions and potential future monetization strategies
premises.evidence_span: we work as an affiliate with commission of 6% on sales... we're also thinking of other ways to monetize in the future.

value.text: Users can discover and shop for fashion items more effectively through a combination of technology and personal styling
value.evidence_span: you can shop what others are searching.

notes: No external knowledge applied; all claims are based on the transcript.
